learning.why: teacher used farmer example and reminded me earthworm makes soil loose, so I now connected part of why it's good, though I still don't get decomposition part.

end.summary: Named ants as animals found in soil and leaf litter.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised naming soil animals and explaining that earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil. They explained that earthworms make soil loose and help hide from predators, but still mixed up whether earthworms harm soil; this was not corrected by the end. At home, look at a picture or garden patch together and sort animals into “helps soil” and “found in soil.”
